prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic editorial portrait of an adult East Asian woman at a winter market. She has a sweet radiant smile with a hint of shyness, gently curved eyes and a relaxed approachable expression. She wears a warm beige-brown short puffy down jacket, a burgundy V-neck knitted vest over a white shirt collar, and holds a glass jar of red hawthorn fruit in both arms. Behind her are multiple glass jars filled with colorful preserved produce on a weathered market ledge. Use an authentic winter-market setting, warm seasonal atmosphere, natural skin texture, soft overcast light, realistic fabric and glass detail, documentary fashion styling and a vertical portrait composition. Preserve the approved adult face reference when provided.
